answer: Each agent bonds a Doppler-stable optical anchor tied to its physical transceiver, so a sybil cluster cannot spoof distinct pulse-position signatures without isolating its shared hardware island from the honest photon-counting array. Nectar rewards flow only to anchors whose measured Doppler residuals match independent ephemeris checks, forcing colluders to split real. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
